'''Kenga''' is a [[Bongo–Bagirmi languages|Bongo–Bagirmi language]] of [[Chad]]. Speakers make up the majority of the population in Kenga canton in [[Bitkine]] sub-prefecture.<ref name=PASISAT>[[Oxfam]] and Office National de Développement Rural (ONDR). 2016.
